places.name: Tirthan Riverside Campsite & Bonfire Haven
places.tagline: Pristine riverside alpine tents surrounded by cedar pines and trout streams
places.description: Pitch under towering pine canopies beside the bubbling Tirthan River. Features luxury canvas tents, private firepits, freshly caught trout barbecue, and night sky astronomy.

places.name: Jibhi Pine Woods Heritage Homestay
places.tagline: Handcrafted Kath-Kuni cedar wood homestay nestled beside cascading waterfalls
places.description: Live with a native Himachali family in a centuries-old slate and cedar mansion. Savor traditional Siddu, organic apple chutneys, and fall asleep to the gentle mountain breeze.

places.name: Kasol Chalal Riverside Glamping Camp
places.tagline: Quiet bohemian riverside bell-tents tucked under deodar canopies
places.description: Escape the main strip to the tranquil banks of Chalal. Enjoy riverside geodesic dome tents, wood-fired bread making, hammocks over clear glacial water, and starlit gatherings.

places.name: Spiti Valley Mud & Stone Monastery Homestay
places.tagline: High-altitude Tibetan mud-brick home with panoramic monastery and Milky Way views
places.description: Experience authentic Spitian hospitality at 3,800m. Stay in a traditional solar-heated mud-brick home with butter tea by the Bukhari stove and breathtaking view of Key Monastery.

places.name: Pangi Valley Remote Alpine Campsite
places.tagline: Raw wilderness expedition campsite beneath the dramatic Sach Pass cliffs
places.description: For genuine adventure seekers: all-weather dome tents surrounded by soaring jagged Himalayan spires, Pangwali village campfires, and untouched trails along the Chenab canyon.

places.name: Parvati Valley Apple Orchard Homestay
places.tagline: Rustic orchard retreat with glacier views, sourdough bakes and organic herbs
places.description: Perched above the valley floor in peaceful Kalga, surrounded by blooming apple trees and mountain mist. Cozy wooden rooms, herbal tea foraging, and serene writing spaces.

experiences.title: Hidden Cedar Forest & Waterfall Trail
experiences.description: Traverse forgotten pathways beneath hundred-year-old cedar trees to a hidden waterfall gorge. Learn native tree lore and enjoy mountain spring water.

experiences.title: Authentic Himachali Dham & Chha Gosht Feast
experiences.description: Sit on traditional jute mats and savor a feast prepared over wood-fired brass cauldrons: Madra, Sepu Vadi, Siddu with ghee, and sweet Meethey Chawal.

experiences.title: Raghupur Fort Sunrise Ridge Trek
experiences.description: Hike through dense oak forests opening into vast 360-degree alpine meadows of Raghupur Fort ruins to catch golden first light touching the Pir Panjal range.

experiences.title: Gushaini Heritage Village & Kath-Kuni Walk
experiences.description: Explore ancient wooden interlocking Kath-Kuni architecture, interact with village elders, see handloom shawl weaving, and visit sacred community deota shrines.

experiences.title: Tirthan River Eco-Camp & Stargazing
experiences.description: Pitch high-grade riverside alpine tents, listen to the gushing river, enjoy an acoustic campfire, and gaze at the Milky Way stretching across Himalayan skies.

locals.name: Rahul Thakur
locals.bio: Born in Shoja near Jalori Pass, Rahul has been guiding travelers through ancient cedar forests, secret waterfall alcoves, and village trails for over 7 years.

locals.name: Sonia Negi
locals.bio: Sonia loves introducing mindful wanderers to organic farming, trout river walks, and centuries-old Kath-Kuni wooden architecture in Gushaini.

locals.name: Vikram Thakur
locals.bio: A native orchardist and historian from Naggar who knows every temple legend, Roerich art history, and offbeat trail in the upper Kullu valley.

locals.name: Pooja Rana
locals.bio: Pooja leads tranquil walks away from crowded tourist hubs, showing you ancient deodar groves, riverside cafes, and quiet viewpoints.

locals.name: Meera Devi
locals.bio: Meera has been preserving the geometric Kullu pattu border craft for over 22 years and welcomes travelers to weave and learn natural dyeing.

locals.name: Tsering Dorje
locals.bio: Certified Mountaineering Institute (ABVIMAS) guide with 11 years leading mindful expeditions across Pin-Parvati, Chandratal, and Kibber wildlife reserve.
